image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) standing on dry, grassy ground. The bird has predominantly black plumage with subtle iridescent sheen on the neck, a short curved beak, and visible red eyebrow combs. The tail is dark and slightly fanned but not in full lyre display. Legs appear feathered down to the feet. White undertail coverts are partially visible near the vent area.
